episodes.final_message: With 3 deadlines today and another coming up soon, it makes total sense that things feel overwhelming right now. Let's shrink the focus: pick just one sub-task and work on it for a single 25-minute block, then take a gentle walk or reach out to a friend for a quick check-in to reset.

Since I don't have your recent sleep or stress check-ins from the last few days, I don't want to guess how you're doing amidst your midterms and deadlines today. How are your energy and stress levels holding up this evening?

It sounds like you're navigating a real blizzard of emotions with your deadlines today, and it's completely understandable to feel overwhelmed. Please remember you don't have to carry this alone; you can reach out to the Counseling Center at Dick's House (603-646-9442) for confidential support or the Academic Skills Center (603-646-2014) for help managing your workload. For now, please try to step away from your screen for just five minutes to take a few slow breaths—you deserve that small moment of peace.
